title: LogT: Logically Think with Images for Visual Search
abstract: arXiv:2611.19200v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Thinking with images empowers vision-language models (VLMs) to use an external Zoom-in tool for fine-grained visual search. Recent works employ supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) with tool-specific designs to enable such capabilities. However, achieving logical reasoning alongside accurate and efficient tool use remains a significant challenge. To address this, we shift the focus away from increasing RL complexity and instead identify SFT data quality as a key bottleneck. We then propose LogT (short for Logically Think with Images), a fully automated SFT data engine that explicitly enforces logic-chain-guided reasoning. LogT generates an SFT dataset featuring challenging, visually grounded questions and structured tool-use traces with human-like logic. We validate our approach by fine-tuning two base models, Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3.5-8B, on the dataset and evaluating them across seven benchmark test sets. We

translated_title: LogT：以逻辑思维结合图像进行视觉搜索
translated_abstract: “图像思维”使视觉语言模型（VLM）能够使用外部的放大（Zoom-in）工具进行细粒度的视觉搜索。近期的工作采用监督微调（SFT）和结合工具特定设计的强化学习（RL）来实现这种能力。然而，在实现准确高效的工具使用的同时保持逻辑推理，仍然是一个重大挑战。为解决这一问题，我们将焦点从增加强化学习的复杂度上移开，转而将SFT数据质量确定为关键瓶颈。为此，我们提出了LogT（Logically Think with Images的缩写），这是一个全自动的SFT数据引擎，明确强制执行逻辑链引导的推理。LogT生成的SFT数据集包含具有挑战性的、有视觉依据的问题，以及具有类人逻辑的结构化工具使用轨迹。我们通过在该数据集上微调两个基础模型（Qwen2.5-VL-7B和InternVL3.5-8B），并在七个基准测试集上进行评估来验证我们的方法。
tldr: LogT是一个全自动的SFT数据引擎，通过生成逻辑链引导的高质量训练数据，使视觉语言模型在细粒度视觉搜索中同时实现逻辑推理与准确高效的工具使用。
en_tdlr: LogT is a fully automated SFT data engine that generates logic-chain-guided training data, enabling vision-language models to achieve logical reasoning alongside accurate and efficient tool use for fine-grained visual search.
